title: AFP: No signs of Chinese drilling in Bajo de Masinloc

blocks.text: MANILA – The Chinese research vessel spotted at Bajo de Masinloc, or Scarborough Shoal, in the West Philippine Sea (WPS) for as long as 28 days showed no signs of conducting drilling operations, a ranking Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) official said Tuesday. “On the Chinese research vessel that was spotted for 25 (to) 28 days in Bajo de Masinloc, the presence and the track would indicate that they were conducting surveillance or research activities. As to any report of drilling activities, there was none that was confirmed nor were there any reports given by our monitoring capabilities,” retired Navy […]...
